content: लिङ्गिन् {%a.%} [लिङ्गमस्त्यस्य इनि] .²1 Having a mark or sign. .²2 Characterized by. .²3 Wearing the maks or badges of, having the appearance of, disguised as, hypocritical, wearing false badges (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); स वर्णिलिङ्गी विदितः समाययौ युधिष्ठिरं द्वैतवने वनेचरः <ls>Ki. 1. 1</ls>; so आर्यलिङ्गिन्. .²4 Furnished with a {%liṅga%}. .²5 Having a right to wear signs or badges. .²6 One whose outward form corresponds with his inward character. .²7 Having a subtle body. --{%m.%} .²1 A religious student, Brāhmaṇa ascetic; अलिङ्गी लिङ्गिवेषेण यो वृत्तिमुपजीवति . स लिङ्गिनां हरत्येनस्तिर्यग्यौनौ च जायते .. <ls>Ms. 4. 200</ls>; स्त्रीलिङ्गिविप्रबालानां प्रहर्तव्यं न कर्हिचित् <ls>Pt. 4. 39</ls>. .²2 A worshipper of Śivaʼs {%liṅga%}. .²3 A hypocrite, pretending devotee, pseudoascetic. .²4 An elephant. .²5 (In logic) That which possesses the {%liṅga%} or middle term; {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} वह्नि is the लिङ्गिन् in the familiar instance पर्वतो वह्निमान् धूमात्. .²6 (Hence) The subject of a proposition. .²7 The Supreme Being (as the sustainer of {%liṅga%}). .²8 The cause or source. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of a Śaiva sect.
